message.content: (1) Yes, the layout looks highly professional and clean, utilizing a modern card-based design with a clear visual hierarchy and a consistent color palette of navy blue, white, and gold accents. (2) The chapter pills are clearly visible at the top of the interface, with "Ch1 Heart of Algebra" currently selected to indicate the active section. (3) The left sidebar is prominently displayed, effectively listing six individual lessons such as "Linear Equations" and "Inequalities" along with their question counts. (4) The hero card is a central feature, displaying the chapter title, author name, and two distinct CTA buttons: "Start Lesson 1.2" and "Open Quiz Center." (5) There are no apparent visual issues; the text is legible, elements are well-spaced without overlapping, and all components from the "Question of the Day" to the "Achievements" grid appear fully rendered and functional. Overall, it is a well-structured and polished educational dashboard.
